sourceBindings.text: Conceptual trainer demonstration only. Bottles, liquid and blank readout are schematic: no specified reagent, amount, real colour/concentration or operating permission. Changing a phase does not perform a laboratory test.

Watch the trainer's analysis and explain the method and result. Do not handle extraction reagents, colour reagents or analytical instruments from this online step. Any actual laboratory operation requires its own site procedure and trainer supervision.
Extract a measured soil portion by the declared method
Filter the suspension to obtain the extract
React a measured portion with the method’s stated reagent
Read with the matching chart or checked instrument
Concept order correct. The method still supplies quantities, chemistry, timing, blanks and calibration; no practical operation passed.
Provide large editable labels, text equivalents for colours, keyboard order controls, glossary help and a readout not dependent on colour alone.

Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.

sourceBindings.text: Learner orders four observed demonstration stages, names the known amount of soil, extractant and reagent as method-specific, and explains that the extraction is an operational index rather than all nutrients in the soil or exactly what roots take up.
Pass only with the full sequence and method limitation. Watching the trainer does not award independent chemical-analysis competence.

Learner labels the units and the laboratory's method for each value and uses a crop- and region-appropriate guide before classifying; identifies fertilizer-label N-P2O5-K2O percentages as different from soil-test ppm.
Pass with correct unit, method and interpretation boundary; copying an example threshold as a universal standard does not pass.

For pH 5.5/P 12 ppm and report placeholders X/Y, learner names the unavailable test basis, crop, region, lime requirement, nutrient recommendation and product details, then states a conditional next step without fabricating a dose.
Pass if missing evidence and conditional direction are explicit. A guessed field rate or unconditional N application fails.
